The Process Architect Plan-to-Produce (m/f/d) supports the Process Owner and Global Process Owner in defining future-state business processes, translating business requirements into solution designs, and ensuring the successful deployment of standardized end-to-end production processes across all manufacturing sites.

Your responsibilities:

- Translate business needs from manufacturing sites into clear process requirements, functional specifications, user requirements, and solution design inputs.
- Collaborate with Solution Architects, IT teams, MES experts, Quality, Warehouse Operations, Planning, and Production stakeholders to design scalable, compliant, and standardized SAP S/4HANA PP-PI processes.
- Support Fit-to-Template workshops, design validation, and decision preparation for template deviations or local requirements.
- Define and maintain process models, process flows, business rules, and documentation for Level 2 and Level 3 Plan-to-Produce processes, ensuring alignment with end-to-end value streams.
- Contribute to master data governance for production-relevant objects such as BOMs, master recipes, routings, work centers/resources, production versions, and planning parameters, in collaboration with Global Data Stewards.
- Support the definition of data migration concepts, cleansing rules, validation checks, and mock-load activities to ensure high data quality for production master data.
- Support test strategy and execution, including preparation of test scenarios, OQ/PQ documentation, defect clarification, business validation, and coordination of site testing activities.
- Deliver process and system training, and support user adoption during deployment, hypercare, and continuous improvement phases.
- Identify process risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and support the Process Owner in prioritization, decision tracking, and project management activities.

Your qualifications:

- University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.
- At least 5 years of relevant experience in production, business process management, ERP transformation, or process architecture, preferably in the pharmaceutical, MedTech, nutrition, or other regulated industry.
- Strong end-to-end understanding of Plan-to-Produce processes, including production planning, production execution, shop-floor operations, quality integration, warehouse integration, and master data dependencies.
- Hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA manufacturing capabilities, including PP-PI, Fiori apps, and related cross-functional integration points.
- Solid understanding of production master data objects.
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex process dependencies and propose pragmatic, standardized solutions.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with global, cross-functional, and site-based teams.
- High learning agility, adaptability to evolving business requirements and technologies, and strong motivation to drive harmonization and continuous improvement.
- Business fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%, depending on project and deployment needs.

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $40 billion. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies or increasing productivity in their laboratories, we are here to support them.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 125,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. It’s a chance to realize your best – professionally and personally.

The job

Are you passionate about applying your chemistry expertise to solve real-world challenges? This 18-month fixed-term role is ideal for scientists who enjoy combining technical problem-solving with meaningful customer interaction.

As a Technical Application Scientist II, you will partner with researchers and customers to resolve complex chemistry-related questions that directly impact their success and the effective use of Thermo Fisher Scientific products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, while continuously expanding your technical knowledge across a diverse chemical product portfolio.

Continuous learning is central to this role. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, stay current with new technologies and applications, and contribute to a collaborative, international team that values innovation, inclusion, and professional growth.

jobs.description:
Job posting no. 20260820

The GWDG is seeking an

HPC Systems & Scheduling Developer (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours per week), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running till October 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (see responsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code is human-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification without AI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is a partner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the German Aerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchers and students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantum computing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection for industry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies a tool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus: Connecting quantum workloads to GWDG’s existing HPC infrastructure. Requires a deep understanding of both classical HPC architectures and the specific characteristics of quantum jobs. The developer will take responsibility for scheduler logic, including:

- SLURM partition mapping
- Optimization of SLURM execution for Quantum Computing Jobs
- Implement HPC transpilation pipelines and, more generally, workflows for HPC/AI pre- and post-processing
- Performance tuning of hybrid workloads
- Implementation of monitoring and benchmarking mechanisms

Requirements

- PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrable industry or research experience
- Ability to code in Python
- Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.
- Demonstrable expertise in optimizing HPC stacks for proper system implementation and tuning
- Experience building and operating software-based services, ensuring long-term maintainability
- Knowledge in QC (quantum computing) job characteristics and resource requirements, and familiarity with compiler/transpiler pipelines
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills
- Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

- Demonstrable experience tuning SLURM (partitioning, QoS, job prioritization policies) in a production HPC environment
- Experience benchmarking and profiling hybrid classical/quantum or GPU workloads
- Experience enabling optimal, resource-efficient operation of hybrid classical/quantum workloads
- Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling for HPC systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)
- Background in systems administration or DevOps for research computing infrastructure
- German B2 or higher

Our offer

- Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working
- A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry
- An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center
- Qualification and further development of your skills
- Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form: https://bewerbermanagement.net/fpnhs

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. The GWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail: jancillie.louw@gwdg.de).

- Fluent English (spoken and written)

- Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)
- Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques
- Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector or tensor-network simulators)
- Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms
- Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The BioProduction Group (BPG) provides the technology, materials and services to develop and produce life-changing medicines efficiently, sustainably and cost-effectively. Through our scientific expertise, differentiated innovations and global network, we help customers advance biologics, vaccines and advanced therapies from development to commercialization. With flagship products like the DynaDrive bioreactor and DynaCellect Magnetic Separation System, BPG supports some of the most innovative breakthrough medicines, helping bring treatments to patients faster and advancing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Our Thermo Fisher Scientific site in Darmstadt is a key hub for the marketing, sales, service and support of our life sciences products. Home to around 300 colleagues, including approximately 120 field-based employees, the site brings together inside sales, our EMEA Customer Contact Center and a dedicated laboratory for customer training. From Darmstadt, we support customers across scientific research with a portfolio of more than 50,000 products, including solutions from leading brands such as Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Gibco and Ion Torrent.

Discover Impactful Work

About the Job

The Industrial Supply Chain Manager (I-SCM) is responsible for managing and optimizing the manufacturing and supply chain network to ensure cost-effective, reliable, and scalable production. The role leads industrialization initiatives such as volume ramp-ups, manufacturing transfers, product changes, and supplier and factory onboardings while serving as the Supply Chain Management representative in industrialization projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the I-SCM ensures that supply chain requirements are fully integrated into project execution, drives capacity and loading strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain performance, efficiency, and resilience.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead Volume Ramp-Up (VRU) activities, manufacturing transfers, supplier and factory onboardings, and product optimization initiatives.
- Represent Supply Chain Management (SCM) in industrialization and Product Change Notification (PCN) projects, ensuring successful implementation and alignment with business objectives.
- Design and implement efficient end-to-end supply chain concepts, including material, capacity, and financial flows across internal and external manufacturing networks.
- Drive capacity planning and loading strategies by balancing internal and external manufacturing resources, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments while optimizing cost, flexibility, capacity utilization, and service levels.
- Establish and lead cross-functional capacity and loading governance processes, including the development and maintenance of planning and loading tools.
- Analyze supply chain, inventory, demand, capacity, and supplier performance data, translating insights into actionable recommendations and management decisions.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools to provide transparency, support decision-making, and monitor supply chain performance.
- Identify and drive process improvements across planning, logistics, production, and supply chain operations to enhance efficiency, visibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
- Support and improve system-driven processes through master data governance, data validation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead or contribute to cross-functional SCM initiatives and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and supply chain optimization.
- Proactively identify supply, capacity, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.

Your Profile

- Master Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Manufacturing, or a comparable industry environment.
- Experience working in project-driven and cross-functional environments; exposure to industrialization or manufacturing transfer projects is considered an advantage.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively in international organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
- High level of ownership, independence, and decision-making capability combined with a hands-on mentality.
- Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage complex activities in dynamic environments.
- Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications; experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships across all organizational levels.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Project & Stakeholder Management
- Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
- Data Analytics & Performance Reporting
- Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
- Problem Solving & Decision Making
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
